source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : VIII', 'Subject : BIOLOGY', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2 Hrs+15mins.'; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A [40 marks] is compulsory; Section B [40 marks] says 'Attempt any four questions' and prints Q2-Q6 (10 marks each), so the pack totals 90. Q1 groups (a)-(g) print only a group total and are kept as one entry each. Q6 a) prints half marks for (i) and (iii) and is kept as one 5-mark entry. Many topics (cell, classification, microorganisms) are not in the Class 8 chapter list and have chapter null. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Name the following : (Only answers) (i) Any one disease caused by bacteria. (ii) The yellow plastid found in flowers and fruits responsible for the yellow colour. (iii) The division of Kingdom Plantae which includes all algae. (iv) An example of a non-communicable disease. (v) The clear spaces found in the cytoplasm of cells. (vi) The bacterium that causes tuberculosis. (vii) The category of animals where the heart is on the ventral side of the body. (viii) Another name for cell membrane.
